# GOAT in Training

> A daily home training app for young athletes aged 6 to 14, used together with a parent. Football, basketball, baseball and softball, hockey and soccer. The plan changes with the athlete's age. The first 7 sessions are free for every athlete; then one family membership covers every athlete in the family. No ads, no chat and no tracking.

The website has a page for each of the app's 178 drills: the steps, a starting amount and what to say. The harder levels are only in the app. This is general training guidance, not medical advice.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://goatintraining.com/): what the app is and how the week works
- [For coaches](https://goatintraining.com/coaches.html): a printable flyer with a QR code for a team
- [Privacy policy](https://goatintraining.com/privacy.html)
- [Support](https://goatintraining.com/support.html)

## Drill groups
- [Sports drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/): 178 sports drills for kids ages 6 to 14 to do at home: speed, jumping, footwork, football, basketball, baseball, softball, hockey and soccer.
- [Speed drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/): 11 speed drills for ages 6 to 14 to do at home: A-skips, sprint starts, flying sprints and more, each with plain steps and a starting amount.
- [Jumping and strength drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/): 18 jumping, landing and body-weight strength drills for ages 6 to 14, with no gym: stick landings, broad jumps, squats, push-ups and more.
- [Footwork and agility drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/): 11 footwork, balance and agility drills for ages 6 to 14 to do at home: jump rope, ladder patterns, the 5-10-5 shuttle and more.
- [Warm-ups and stretching for young athletes](https://goatintraining.com/drills/warm-up/): Four short warm-up and stretching routines for young athletes, ages 6 to 14: a dynamic warm-up, a quick-feet warm-up, a control warm-up and a stretch.
- [Football drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/): 38 football drills for ages 6 to 14 to do at home, in 5 sets: Hands, Throwing, Hand-eye, Carry and run and Routes and releases.
- [Basketball drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/): 24 basketball drills for ages 6 to 14 to do at home, in 3 sets: Handles and shot; Finishing and footwork; Pass, defend, rebound.
- [Baseball and softball drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/baseball/): 24 baseball and softball drills for ages 6 to 14 to do at home, in 3 sets: Fielding and swings, Throwing and Hitting and running.
- [Hockey drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/hockey/): 24 hockey drills for ages 6 to 14 to do at home, in 3 sets: Stickhandling, Shooting and Passing.
- [Soccer drills for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/soccer/): 24 soccer drills for ages 6 to 14 to do at home, in 3 sets: Ball control, Passing and Moves and finishing.

## Drills
- [A-skips: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/a-skips.html): A-skips break running into one piece at a time: knee up, toe up, foot down under the hips. A speed drill for ages 6 to 14. Jog first.
- [Sprint form: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/sprint-form.html): Sprint form slows running down to one step at a time: the knee comes up and the foot punches straight down under the hips. A speed drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [First step: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/first-step.html): This drill practices reacting to something they see and getting moving in one short step. A speed drill for ages 6 to 14. Go the moment Coach moves the ball.
- [Start races: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/start-races.html): Getting up from the ground and into a sprint teaches the body to sort itself out fast. A speed drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Sprints: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/sprints.html): Short, full-effort sprints with full rest let your athlete practice running at their true top speed. A speed drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Power skips: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/power-skips.html): Power skips ask for as much push off the ground as possible on every skip. A speed drill for ages 6 to 14. Skip for height. Big knee, big arm.
- [Chase tag: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/chase-tag.html): Chase tag turns sprinting into a game, so your athlete runs hard without thinking about form. A speed drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Flying sprints: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/flying-sprints.html): Flying sprints let an older athlete reach top speed with a running start, so they can practice holding that speed. A speed drill for ages 11 to 14.
- [Sprint and stop: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/sprint-and-stop.html): Stopping under control is its own skill, separate from running fast. A speed drill for ages 11 to 14. Stop within three steps of the line. Low and balanced.
- [Falling starts: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/falling-starts.html): Falling starts teach a forward lean that comes from the ankles, not the waist. A speed drill for ages 12 to 14.
- [Reaction starts: a speed drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/speed/reaction-starts.html): Reaction starts practice responding to a signal instead of a countdown. A speed drill for ages 6 to 14. Go on a clap.
- [Stick landings: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/stick-landings.html): Stick landings practice the part of jumping kids often skip: landing quietly with knees bent. A power drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Broad jumps: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/broad-jumps.html): Broad jumps practice using the arms and legs together to jump forward, then landing under control. A power drill for ages 6 to 14. One jump at a time.
- [Seated jumps: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/seated-jumps.html): Starting from a still seat takes away the bounce, so your athlete has to jump with leg push alone. A power drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Pogo hops: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/pogo-hops.html): Pogo hops practice quick, springy contacts with the ground through stiff ankles. A power drill for ages 6 to 14. Small, quick bounces. Stiff ankles, quiet feet.
- [Skater jumps: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/skater-jumps.html): Skater jumps practice pushing off one leg sideways and landing on the other. A power drill for ages 6 to 14. Hold each landing for a full second.
- [Animal walks: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/animal-walks.html): Animal walks get the arms, legs and middle working together. A power drill for ages 6 to 14. Bear crawl, crab walk and frog jumps. 10 yards each.
- [Squats: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/squats.html): Squats practice bending the hips and knees together while staying balanced over the feet. A power drill for ages 6 to 14. Heels down, chest up.
- [Push-ups: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/push-ups.html): Push-ups practice holding the body in one straight line while the arms push. A power drill for ages 6 to 14. Hands on a bench or step.
- [Bar hang: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/bar-hang.html): Bar hangs practice grip and keeping the shoulders steady while holding body weight. A power drill for ages 6 to 14. Tight grip, still body.
- [Cone hops: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/cone-hops.html): Cone hops link several two-foot jumps in a row, each with a controlled landing. A power drill for ages 11 to 14.
- [Plank: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/plank.html): The plank practices holding the middle of the body still and straight. A power drill for ages 11 to 14. Straight as a board. Rest 30 seconds between rounds.
- [Squat jumps: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/squat-jumps.html): Holding the half squat first removes the bounce, so each jump starts from a set position. A power drill for ages 12 to 14.
- [Wall hinge: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/wall-hinge.html): The wall hinge teaches moving from the hips while the back stays flat. A power drill for ages 12 to 14. Hips back to the wall with a flat back.
- [Floor pulls: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/floor-pulls.html): Floor pulls practice squeezing the shoulder blades together and pulling with the upper back. A power drill for ages 12 to 14.
- [Carries: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/carries.html): Carries practice standing tall and walking steadily with weight in each hand. A power drill for ages 12 to 14. One in each hand.
- [Chest throws: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/chest-throws.html): Chest throws practice pushing something away fast, using the legs and arms together with a step. A power drill for ages 12 to 14. Ball at your chest.
- [Jumps: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/jumps.html): This pairs a forward jump with an upward one, so your athlete practices jumping in both directions in one practice. A power drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Body-control circuit: a power drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/power/body-control-circuit.html): The circuit strings the week's body control moves together with little rest. A power drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Jump rope: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/jump-rope.html): Jump rope practices rhythm and staying light on the balls of the feet. A footwork drill for ages 6 to 14. Two feet together. Rest 30 seconds between rounds.
- [Ladder footwork: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/ladder-footwork.html): Ladder footwork practices placing the feet quickly and exactly where they need to go. A footwork drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [One-leg balance catch: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/one-leg-balance-catch.html): Catching on one leg asks your athlete to balance while their attention is on the ball. A footwork drill for ages 6 to 14. Easy tosses right to your chest.
- [Pivot and go: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/pivot-and-go.html): Pivot and go practices turning around and sprinting in one move. A footwork drill for ages 6 to 14. Head and chest around first, hips low, then sprint.
- [Curve sprints: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/curve-sprints.html): Curve sprints practice running fast on a bend. A footwork drill for ages 6 to 14. Two each way. Lean in and stay close to the cones.
- [5-10-5 shuttle: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/5-10-5-shuttle.html): The 5-10-5 shuttle practices two full changes of direction at speed, with a touch of the line each time. A footwork drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Mirror drill: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/mirror-drill.html): The mirror drill practices reading another person's movement and staying in front of them. A footwork drill for ages 6 to 14. Stay right in front of Coach.
- [Plant and cut: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/plant-and-cut.html): Plant and cut practices changing direction off one foot at a planned spot. A footwork drill for ages 11 to 14. Jog in. Plant, cut and go.
- [Box drill: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/box-drill.html): The box drill links four ways of moving: forward, sideways, backward and sideways again. A footwork drill for ages 11 to 14.
- [Shuffle and stick: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/shuffle-and-stick.html): Shuffle and stick practices moving sideways fast, then stopping still on one leg. A footwork drill for ages 12 to 14.
- [L run: a footwork drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/footwork/l-run.html): The L run practices a sharp, square cut at a corner, then sprinting out of it. A footwork drill for ages 12 to 14. Three-quarter speed.
- [Dynamic warm-up for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/warm-up/dynamic-warm-up.html): This warm-up moves through skipping, knee lifts, kicks and sideways steps, so the legs and hips work in many directions. A warm-up for ages 6 to 14.
- [Quick-feet warm-up for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/warm-up/quick-feet-warm-up.html): This warm-up gets the feet moving with rope, ladder patterns and line hops before harder work. A warm-up for ages 6 to 14.
- [Control warm-up for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/warm-up/control-warm-up.html): The control warm-up adds lunges, squats, balance and landings to the usual jogging. A warm-up for ages 12 to 14.
- [Stretch: a rest-day stretching routine for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/warm-up/stretch.html): This routine gently stretches the hips, hamstrings, calves and shoulders on a day with no running or jumping. A rest-day stretching routine for ages 6 to 14.
- [Tennis ball wall catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/tennis-ball-wall-catches.html): Tennis ball wall catches: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Throw at a wall and catch with one hand.
- [High catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/high-catches.html): High catches: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From 5 yards. Thumbs together, hands make a diamond.
- [Low catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/low-catches.html): Low catches: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From 5 yards. Pinkies together, bend your knees, scoop.
- [Over the shoulder: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/over-the-shoulder.html): Over the shoulder: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Jogging. Let the ball drop into your hands.
- [One-hand catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/one-hand-catches.html): One-hand catches: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Soft tosses from 5 yards. Squeeze it.
- [Catch and tuck: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/catch-and-tuck.html): Catch and tuck: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Catch, tuck high and tight, and run past Coach, who swats at the ball.
- [Sideline catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/sideline-catches.html): Sideline catches: a football drill for ages 11 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Jog to the line. Catch, then tap both feet down inside it.
- [Grip and flick: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/grip-and-flick.html): Grip and flick: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Lying on your back. Flick it straight up and catch it.
- [Football one-knee throws drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/one-knee-throws.html): Football one-knee throws: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From 5 yards. Slow and smooth.
- [Slide in the pocket: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/slide-in-the-pocket.html): Slide in the pocket: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From 5 yards. Slide, stop, step, throw.
- [Football target throws drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/target-throws.html): Target throws add aim to the motion, the way a passer has to hit a receiver who is open in a small window between defenders. A football drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Throw on the move: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/throw-on-the-move.html): Throw on the move: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Jogging. Coach is 5 yards away.
- [Three-step drop: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/three-step-drop.html): Three-step drop: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Walk the steps first, then throw to Coach 5 yards away.
- [Slide and throw: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/slide-and-throw.html): Slide and throw: a football drill for ages 11 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Drop, slide two steps, set your feet, and throw to Coach 8 yards away.
- [Drop catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/drop-catches.html): Drop catches: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Catch it after one bounce.
- [Wall ball from behind: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/wall-ball-from-behind.html): Wall ball from behind: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Underhand throws. Let it bounce once, then catch it.
- [Around the post: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/around-the-post.html): Around the post: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Soft throws from 4 yards, right at your hands.
- [Pump and catch: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/pump-and-catch.html): Pump and catch: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From 5 yards. Coach throws on ten.
- [One-eye catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/one-eye-catches.html): One-eye catches: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Underhand tosses from 4 yards with a tennis ball or a soft ball.
- [Two-ball catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/two-ball-catches.html): Two-ball catches train wide vision and calm hands, which helps a player see the whole field instead of locking on one thing. A football drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Blind turn catches: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/blind-turn-catches.html): Blind turn catches: a football drill for ages 11 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Coach shouts early. Turn the same way every time.
- [Handoffs: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/handoffs.html): Handoffs: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Walking. Four from each side.
- [Football plant and cut drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/plant-and-cut.html): Football plant and cut: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Jog in, sharp cut out.
- [Hold on tight: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/hold-on-tight.html): Hold on tight trains ball security, so a runner keeps the ball when a defender reaches in to strip it during a run. A football drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Flag pulls: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/flag-pulls.html): Flag pulls: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Coach walks straight at you.
- [Switch hands: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/switch-hands.html): Switch hands: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Walking.
- [Catch and go: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/catch-and-go.html): Catch and go connects a short catch to turning upfield, which is what a receiver does after a quick pass to gain extra yards. A football drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Read and cut: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/read-and-cut.html): Read and cut: a football drill for ages 11 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Coach steps early. Jog in and make one sharp cut.
- [Circle drill: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/circle-drill.html): Circle drill: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Jog it. Lean in with small, quick steps, then break out for the catch.
- [Shuffle jabs: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/shuffle-jabs.html): Shuffle jabs: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Learn the zigzag. Low hips, quick feet, one sharp jab at each cone.
- [Jab step: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/jab-step.html): A jab step makes the defender think the receiver is going one way, which opens space to break the other way. A football drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Square cut: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/square-cut.html): The square cut is the sharp sideways break of an out route. A football drill for ages 6 to 14. Three short steps, plant, cut. No rounding the corner.
- [Rocker step: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/rocker-step.html): The rocker step sells a short stop, so the defender comes forward, and then the receiver runs past them. A football drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Crossover release: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/crossover-release.html): A crossover release is how a receiver gets off the line when a defender lines up right in front. A football drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Beat the press: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/beat-the-press.html): Beat the press: a football drill for ages 11 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Coach stays still. Fake, swipe, go.
- [Route tree: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/route-tree.html): Route tree: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Hitch, slant, out and go. Sharp cut, head snaps around, hands ready.
- [Stance and get-off: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/stance-and-get-off.html): Stance and get-off: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Fire out the moment Coach moves the ball.
- [Flag pursuit: a football drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/football/flag-pursuit.html): Flag pursuit: a football drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Coach jogs.
- [Ball wraps: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/ball-wraps.html): Ball wraps: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Around the waist, the knees and the head. 45 seconds each.
- [Pound dribbles: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/pound-dribbles.html): Pound dribbles: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Waist high. Push the ball down hard and look at Coach, not the ball.
- [Dribble on the move: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/dribble-on-the-move.html): Dribble on the move: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Walking. Keep the ball at your side, not in front of your feet.
- [Form shots: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/form-shots.html): Form shots groove one repeatable shooting motion close to the hoop, the base for every jump shot and free throw in a game. A basketball drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Layups: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/layups.html): Layups: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From one step, no dribble. Use the backboard.
- [Basketball passing drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/passing.html): Basketball passing: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From about 6 feet. Step into every pass.
- [Move and pull up: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/move-and-pull-up.html): Move and pull up: a basketball drill for ages 11 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Crossover at the cone, one dribble, and a shot from close.
- [Jump stops: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/jump-stops.html): Jump stops: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Walking speed.
- [Pivots: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/pivots.html): Pivots: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Quarter turns, forward and backward.
- [Power layups: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/power-layups.html): Power layups: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. No dribble.
- [Free throws: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/free-throws.html): Free throws: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From a close line. Same routine every shot.
- [Other-hand layups: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/other-hand-layups.html): Other-hand layups: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From one step, no dribble.
- [Fake and step through: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/fake-and-step-through.html): Fake and step through: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. No defender. Fake, step, finish.
- [Finish through a bump: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/finish-through-a-bump.html): Finish through a bump: a basketball drill for ages 11 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. A light bump, on your strong-hand side.
- [Basketball wall passes drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/wall-passes.html): Basketball wall passes: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Chest passes.
- [Catch ready: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/catch-ready.html): Catch ready: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Coach passes from 6 feet.
- [Closeouts: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/closeouts.html): Closeouts: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Sprint, chop, hand up.
- [Rebound and chin: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/rebound-and-chin.html): Rebound and chin: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Two hands every time.
- [Rebound and outlet: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/rebound-and-outlet.html): Rebound and outlet links the rebound to the first pass, the play that starts a fast break after the other team misses. A basketball drill for ages 6 to 14.
- [Basketball give and go drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/give-and-go.html): Basketball give and go: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Walk through it first, then jog.
- [Guard the ball: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/guard-the-ball.html): Guard the ball: a basketball drill for ages 11 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Coach goes at half speed and changes direction once.
- [Defensive slides: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/defensive-slides.html): Defensive slides: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Slide across and back.
- [Attack the hoop: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/attack-the-hoop.html): Attack the hoop: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. No defender. One or two dribbles, then the layup.
- [Spot shooting: a basketball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/basketball/spot-shooting.html): Spot shooting: a basketball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. Five spots, close in.
- [Play catch: a baseball and softball drill for kids](https://goatintraining.com/drills/baseball/play-catch.html): Play catch: a baseball and softball drill for ages 6 to 14, with steps and a starting amount. From about 20 feet. Easy throws. Point, step, throw.
